# Spyderco, Inc.

> Spyderco is a leading American knife manufacturer based in Golden, Colorado, specializing in innovative folding knives, sharpeners, and outdoor gear.

Spyderco, Inc. designs and manufactures high-quality knives and knife accessories, including folding knives, fixed blades, and sharpening tools. The company is known for its distinctive round hole design and commitment to American manufacturing, offering both premium collections and value-oriented product lines.

## Key Topics

- Folding Knives
- USA-Made Knives
- Outdoor Knives
- CPM S90V® Steel
- Sprint Run®
- Autonomy™
- Bodacious™
- Specialty Knives
- Knife Sharpeners
- Apparel
- Golden, Colorado
- Spyderco Factory Outlet Store
- Value Folders
- Knife Manufacturer
